sloka: न तावदेष दुष्टात्मा शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः ।हन्तुं चापि समासाद्य वरदानेन दुर्जयः ।। ७.२७.१५ ॥
transliteration: na tāvadeṣa duṣṭātmā śakyo jetuṁ surāsuraiḥ ।hantuṁ cāpi samāsādya varadānena durjayaḥ ।। 7.27.15 ॥

translations.english: The Lord explained that this evil-souled Ravana is currently unconquerable by gods or asuras, and cannot be killed even if approached, due to the boon he has received.
